label: Deactivate instance triggers
description: Turn off one instance's per-instance triggers (park, hibernate or wipe), with `running` deciding what happens to its runs in flight.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance id your program gives it (`user-42`).

inputs.name: only
inputs.description: Only these triggers. Unwired: every per-instance trigger.

inputs.name: triggers
inputs.label: Triggers
inputs.description: Park keeps everything that arrives (calls, answers, the trigger's own fires) and runs it once the trigger is back, a caller on a route held on the line; hibernate does the same for `graceMinutes` with its questions hidden, then takes nothing more; wipe drops it all.

inputs.name: running
inputs.label: Running work
inputs.description: The instance's runs still going: wait lets them finish, cancel stops them. `wipe` needs cancel.

inputs.name: graceMinutes
inputs.label: Grace minutes
inputs.description: Hibernate only: how long it keeps accepting.

inputs.name: includeSelf
inputs.label: Stop this run too
inputs.description: On: this run is cancelled too when it is one of the runs reached.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the triggers are down; under `running: wait` their runs may still be finishing.

then.message: DeactivateInstanceTriggers '{id}' names {names} in `only`, which is no per-instance trigger of this program. Name each the way the program writes it (`inbox`, `work.inbox` inside a group, or `one.inbox` inside an included file).
DeactivateInstanceTriggers '{id}' wipes the triggers but lets running work finish. Wiping drops what the runs still need, so set `running` to cancel, or pick park or hibernate for `triggers`.
